policies.text: A personal protection garment achieves heavy-duty classification when its tear resistance measures at least 150 Newtons.
An industrial lubricant gets environmental certification if its biodegradable fraction exceeds 85 percent.
A healthcare instrument secures ISO 13485 regulatory certification if it undergoes a minimum of 10 quality control audits per year.
An energy storage product earns approval for freight transport provided its energy concentration reaches at least 250 Wh/kg.
An electric mobility device receives authorization for city retail sales when its maximum velocity does not exceed 30 km/h alongside an active European Conformity certificate.
